_about: Sal, 2026-10-31; read by the server (server_items.gd _goals_data) and shown in the Journal. Starter goals for the first island, taken from TUTORIAL_FIRST_30_MIN.md (the guide's text is the source of truth for hint wording). Format for a coder: `goals` is an ordered list; each goal has `id`, `title`, `hint` (plain text shown in the goal list), `after` (goal ids that must be done first; empty = available at start), `check` (one of: {event, count, what?} fired by the server when the thing happens, {have_item, count} true while the pack holds that many, {made_item, count} counted when a craft finishes, {got_item, count} counted when the player gathers it first-hand (not trades, rewards, refunds or admin gives), {have_item_any, count}), and `stage` (the progression stage; the goal pays that stage's copper from data/items/goal_rewards.json, coins only). A goal completes once and is saved per character (characters.json `goals_done`). Events to emit in server_items.gd: drink, tree_felled, fire_lit, ate_food, placed(what), carcass_worked.

goals.title: Drink fresh water
goals.hint: Drink fresh water from a river, stream, lake or spring: stand at its edge and press E. Sea water is too salty to drink.

goals.title: Gather plant fibre
goals.hint: Nettles and tall grass give plant fibre. Press E on a plant.

goals.title: Twist twine
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I), pick Twine and craft it: 3 plant fibre make 1 twine.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Axe
goals.hint: 1 stone, 1 stick and 2 twine make a Stone - Axe. Stones lie loose on the ground (most on slopes) and sticks under the trees: press E to pick them up. Put the axe on the hotbar to use it.

goals.title: Fell a tree
goals.hint: Hold the axe and strike a tree again and again. It breaks into logs, sticks and leaves when it lands.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Hammer
goals.hint: Make a Stone - Hammer from a stone, a stick and a twine. You build and repair with it, and it breaks stones, copper ore, tin ore and coal from boulders (iron needs a bronze or better pick).

goals.title: Light a fire
goals.hint: Craft a Campfire in the inventory (I) from 6 sticks and 16 stones, then hold it and click the ground to place it. Put sticks on it with F, then press E near it to light it. When the loose stones round camp run out, hold your Stone - Hammer and strike a boulder: each blow breaks off a stone.

goals.title: Make the wooden tools
goals.hint: Craft both in the inventory (I), keeping a stone in your pack: a Wooden - Hoe (2 sticks, 1 twine) treads paths and breaks ground for beds, and a Wooden - Shovel (2 sticks) digs clay, sand and bog iron.

goals.title: Tread a path from camp to the water
goals.hint: Hold the hoe and left click along the ground from your fire towards the water. Or hold Shift and right click at one end (point A), then at the other (point B): the ground between is levelled and the path laid by itself. Paths are faster to walk. Each stroke on fresh ground lays one patch; a stroke on ground already trodden adds none.

goals.title: Eat something wild
goals.hint: Pick berries or fruit with E and eat them. Put raw meat in the fire with F; cook plants in a pot.

goals.title: Build a lean-to
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Lean-to: 20 sticks, 60 leaves and 6 twine. Build it with the open side towards you. A felled broadleaf tree (oak, birch, beech) drops about a hundred leaves in heaps round where its crown lands: pick them up with E. Pines, spruces and firs drop none, and a bush chopped with the axe gives 10 to 20.

goals.title: Make a bed
goals.hint: Make a bed and place it in your lean-to: a Thatch - Bed from your pack (10 thatch from thatch grass or heather, 4 sticks, 2 twine), or a Straw - Bed from the hammer's build list (hold the hammer, press R and type straw in the search box: 12 straw, 6 sticks, 2 twine). Any bed counts.

goals.title: Build a Workbench
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Wooden - Workbench: 16 sticks, 6 twine and 8 stones. At it you make cobblestones, stone blocks, wooden pins, the Scraper and more. When the loose stones round camp run out, hold your Stone - Hammer and strike a boulder: each blow breaks off a stone.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Spear
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I) and craft a Wooden - Spear from 1 stick (keep a stone in your pack). Then craft a Stone - Spear from the Wooden - Spear, 2 twine and 1 stone.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Knife
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I) and craft a Stone - Knife: 2 stones and a stick. You carve, skin and cut with it. When the loose stones round camp run out, hold your Stone - Hammer and strike a boulder: each blow breaks off a stone.

goals.title: Make every stone tool
goals.hint: Craft the rest of the stone set in the inventory (I): a Stone - Pickaxe (3 stones, 2 sticks, 2 twine) breaks boulders and takes copper, tin and coal, and a Stone - Saw (2 stones, 1 stick, 1 twine) cuts logs into boards by hand. With your Stone - Axe, Stone - Hammer and Stone - Knife that is all five.

goals.title: Make a Fishing spear
goals.hint: With a knife in your pack, open the inventory (I) and craft a Fishing spear from 1 stick (the knife is kept). It spears fish in shallow water.

goals.title: Catch a fish
goals.hint: Hold the Fishing spear, stand still (not swimming) within reach of water between ankle and waist deep, and jab it in. Later a Fishing rod (2 sticks, 2 twine and a Hook carved from 1 bone) or a Fishing net (3 rope, 4 stones) catches more.

goals.title: Hunt an animal and work the body
goals.hint: Crouch (C) to creep close to an animal (a rabbit is the easiest), then throw your spear: hold right click to aim, left click to throw. A wounded deer bleeds; follow its blood trail until it falls. Then hold your knife and work the body: meat, hide and bone. You need them for jerky, warm clothes and a fishing hook; bigger animals such as deer, boar and badger also give fat for candles.

goals.title: Snare small game
goals.hint: Make a Snare (3 twine and 2 sticks) and set it on a rabbit run: a thin line of matted grass leading out from a warren. Rabbits come out along their runs from dusk to dawn, so set it in the evening and look in the morning. Press E on the snare to collect the catch and set it again, then lay the catch on the ground and work it with a knife.

goals.title: Sell to Hob
goals.hint: Talk to Hob the trader at the camp with E, ask what he buys, and sell him something from your pack. Even stones sell.

goals.title: Fill Hob's order
goals.hint: Talk to Hob with E and ask: Any order for today? Bring him what he asks for and he pays for it. He gives one order a day.
